summary:
Iteration 11 — Seasonal Growing Journal PDF (paywalled). ALL acceptance criteria PASS (8/8 backend pytest + 4/4 frontend Playwright flows).

BACKEND (8/8 pytest pass in 96s):
- POST /api/seasonal-pdf London/UK month=3 en portrait + access_token='test-token-pdf-smoke' → 200, Content-Type application/pdf, starts with %PDF-, >=4KB.
- POST /api/seasonal-pdf Paris/FR month=4 fr landscape + valid token → 200 application/pdf %PDF.
- pypdf text extraction confirms all 4 section headings present: 'Sow & plant this month', 'Harvest now', 'Tasks', 'Pest watch'.
- POST without access_token → 402 'Access required — pay £5 once to unlock.'
- POST with bogus 'totally-bogus-not-in-db' token → 402 'Access required'.
- POST with month=13 → 400.
- Regression /api/guidance London/March/en → 200 with plant_now/harvest_now/tasks/pests lists.
- Regression /api/plants?language=en → 200, list of 32 plants including 'tomato'.

FRONTEND (Playwright on /calendar via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL):
- Button [data-testid=download-seasonal-pdf] visible — labelled 'Download seasonal PDF'.
- Unpaid state (localStorage clean): Lock icon present in button. Click opens PaywallModal (data-testid='paywall-modal'). Network observer recorded ZERO requests to /api/seasonal-pdf during the unpaid click — paywall short-circuits before fetch as designed.
- Paid state (localStorage seeded with the ACTUAL keys the app reads: 'patchpot.access.v1'='test-token-pdf-smoke' AND 'patchpot.access.paid.v1'='1'): button swaps to Download icon (Lock no longer shown). Click triggers POST /api/seasonal-pdf → 200, content-type application/pdf. window.open() was invoked exactly once with a blob: URL (verified via stubbed window.open: ['blob:https://grow-by-season-1.preview.emergentagent.com/...']). PaywallModal does NOT appear in paid flow.
- No JS console errors during either flow.
action_items: DOCS-ONLY: The review-request specified the frontend localStorage key as 'pp_access_token', but the actual code in /app/frontend/src/hooks/usePaywall.js uses TOKEN_KEY='patchpot.access.v1' (with companion cache key 'patchpot.access.paid.v1'='1'). The implementation is internally consistent — Calendar.jsx, PaywallModal.jsx and usePaywall.js all use the same key. No code change needed; just align future agent-to-agent notes / docs to the actual key names so seed instructions are correct on first try.
critical_code_review_comments: Positive: paywall is properly enforced server-side — bogus tokens return 402 before any LLM/PDF work happens. Token compared via db.access_grants.find_one which is the same source-of-truth used by /api/access/check.
Positive: pdf_seasonal.py escapes Paragraph input (handles & < > safely) and uses KeepTogether per item, so items don't split awkwardly across pages.
Positive: seasonal-pdf reuses get_guidance() → benefits from existing Mongo cache; warm region/month responses return PDFs in <2s.
Positive: Calendar.jsx correctly revokes the blob URL after 60s (memory hygiene) and uses noopener,noreferrer on the new tab.
Minor design note: when the user closes the new PDF tab quickly, the 60s URL.revokeObjectURL still runs harmlessly — fine. No action required.
Style: server.py is 1500+ lines and well past the 700-line guideline — splitting paywall/PDF/AI routes into modules would aid maintainability, but not a blocker.
test_credentials: Backend access_token: 'test-token-pdf-smoke' (seeded into db.access_grants by the test fixture). Frontend localStorage keys: 'patchpot.access.v1'='test-token-pdf-smoke' AND 'patchpot.access.paid.v1'='1'. The frontend does NOT use 'pp_access_token' as the review note implied.
seed_data_creation: Test fixture upserts {token:'test-token-pdf-smoke', email:'test@test.com', package_id:'lifetime'} into db.access_grants. The seed is intentionally NOT torn down so it remains available for ad-hoc manual retesting and for the frontend paid-flow simulation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seed token 'test-token-pdf-smoke' is already in db.access_grants — pytest fixture upserts it idempotently. To simulate the paid frontend flow, set BOTH localStorage keys: 'patchpot.access.v1'='test-token-pdf-smoke' and 'patchpot.access.paid.v1'='1' (cache flag prevents an optimistic-flash to unpaid). After page reload, click data-testid='download-seasonal-pdf' to trigger a POST to /api/seasonal-pdf; the response is a blob opened via window.open(blob:...). To assert window.open without actually opening a tab, stub it via page.evaluate before the click. pypdf (or PyPDF2) is now installed at the system level so PDF text-extraction asserts work out of the box.
